name: nexus-bosses
title: Nexus Bosses
author: Alex Green
description: Nine summonable bosses in three circles on Nexus. Craft a summon beacon, light it on Nexus and defend your base. Beating a whole circle opens the next one; beating all three opens the warp drive (a startup setting). Nexus has no ordinary nests or worms: its enemies come only from the beacons.
